Game.title: Game
Game.description: Represents a Tic-Tac-Toe match document (AI or Multiplayer). Game board state is derived by replaying the events subcollection.

code.description: Short 6-character uppercase alphanumeric join code matching the document ID.

aiDifficulty.description: Minimax AI difficulty level or 'none' for multiplayer.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the match creator.

hostName.description: Display name of the match creator.

hostSymbol.description: Board symbol assigned to the host.

guestUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the joined opponent, 'AI_BOT' for AI matches, or empty string when waiting.

guestName.description: Display name of the guest player or 'Minimax AI'.

playerUids.description: Bounded list (1 to 2) of human participant UIDs for access control and queries.

eventCount.description: Monotonically increasing count of events in the events subcollection.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the match was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest match update.

GameEvent.title: GameEvent
GameEvent.description: Immutable event-sourcing record representing either a board move or a rollback to a prior turn.

createdByUid.description: UID of the authenticated user who submitted the event.

playerUids.description: Bounded list (1 to 2) of human participant UIDs matching the parent game for secure list queries.

actorUid.description: UID of the acting player or 'AI_BOT' for computer moves.

actorName.description: Display name of the acting player or 'Minimax AI'.

symbol.description: Mark placed on MOVE ('X' or 'O'), or empty string for ROLLBACK.

cell.description: Board index 0..8 for MOVE, or -1 for ROLLBACK.

targetTurn.description: Target turn index 0..9 for ROLLBACK, or -1 for MOVE.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the event was committed.

/games/{gameId}.description: Stores Tic-Tac-Toe match metadata and participant access control.

/games/{gameId}/events/{eventId}.description: Append-only event log of every move and turn rollback for a match.
